evals.name: support-engineer-hm-intro-full-inputs
evals.prompt: I've got a 30 min zoom with Marco, the support engineering manager at Supabase, on Wednesday at 11am PT. The recruiter's email, the posting and my resume are attached. Can you prep me? I want something I can keep open during the call.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML briefing book for this specific hiring-manager intro, with answers in beats, sourced questions, honest gap framing (TypeScript, external developers), the 4-hour Eastern overlap settled first, no invented candidate facts, and a list of questions/gaps for the candidate.
assertions: Produces exactly one self-contained HTML book
No leftover template placeholders
Spoken answers are in beats with bold cues (>= 15 beats)
Has Cues only toggle and auto index
At least 3 questions to ask are grounded in a cited source URL
Unknown candidate details are marked as highlighted gaps
Writes down questions for the candidate (>= 3)
No invented candidate facts (judged)
Settles the US-Eastern overlap requirement
Frames the TypeScript gap honestly on a Frame card

evals.name: cx-engineer-hm-intro-with-candidate-profile
evals.prompt: Prepping for a 45-minute video call with Dana, head of customer experience at Linear, on Monday 9am PT, for the Customer Experience Engineer role. My candidate-profile.md, the posting and the recruiter note are in this folder: evals/files/eval3/. Build me the briefing book.
evals.expected_output: A briefing book that draws stories and motivations from the candidate profile (2am replay pages, 60-day deprecation policy), frames the GraphQL gap as the profile states, never mentions previous salary, and needs few highlighted gaps.
assertions: Produces exactly one self-contained HTML book
No leftover template placeholders
Spoken answers are in beats with bold cues (>= 15 beats)
Has Cues only toggle and auto index
At least 3 questions to ask are grounded in a cited source URL
Unknown candidate details are marked as highlighted gaps
Writes down questions for the candidate (>= 3)
No invented candidate facts (judged)
Uses the profile's real motivations and outcomes
Frames the GraphQL gap on a Frame card
Needs clearly fewer gaps when a profile exists (< 30; no-profile books had 35-46)
Never mentions previous salary
